name: vente
description: Search job leads with verified hiring manager contacts from high stress companies

interface.longDescription: Vente AI connects ChatGPT to your Vente account to help recruiters explore job leads and prioritise business-development opportunities. Search and filter leads across your lists, review job details and company information, access hiring-manager contacts with employment verification and validated contact details where available, and identify companies experiencing high hiring stress with supporting signals. Analyse hiring activity, summarise relevant opportunities, and keep lead and pipeline status up to date. Vente only accesses the data available to the account you connect.
defaultPrompt: Write draft emails to my recent leads in Vente
Summarise the three most exciting leads from Vente today
Generate a market report across my Vente leads, in downloadable PDF format
